title: The Listening Room @ Spence Manor| Music Row| Pool
description:
Welcome to Music Row’s Spence Manor, home of world-famous musicians including Elvis Presley, Paul McCartney and Johnny Cash.  Most artists would stay here when in town to record at nearby studios. This condo was designed to bring back the luxury that these musicians enjoyed. It is at the center of all Nashville entertainment. On Music Row this condo is walkable to Demonbruen, The Gulch, Midtown, Lower Broadway, and Vanderbilt.

The space
Located on Music Row, this space offers the closest proximity to the action of downtown Music City. Our amazing one-bedroom condo is perfect for any couple or small group looking to soak up this vibrant city!

★ Guitar Shaped Pool- (Open between May and the beginning of October)
★ Incredible History
★ Hottest Area in Nashville
★ Safe Neighborhood
★ Professionally Designed
★ Multiple Luxury Amenities

Enjoy your time staying with us!

Guest access
You will receive access instructions at 11 a.m. day of your arrival via your Airbnb inbox.

Other things to note
For additional guests, there is a twin-size roll-away bed and the two chairs convert to a single bed.
